items.title: How this field hires a master's student
items.detail: Big pharma opens structured summer programs between September and November and often prefers or requires a PhD for biostatistics seats; read the qualification line before the title. Amgen runs a separate master's internship inside its statistics group (posted October 26), next to PhD-preferred wording. Moderna's biostatistics intern names master's students outright, while its epidemiology and biomarker statistics seats are PhD only. Regeneron posted its whole 2027 summer wave on October 28 and says some biostatistics projects suit PhD students better, without excluding a master's student. Gilead's October 16 batch listed PhD as *preferred* on most statistics reqs and still took master's students; its research AI seats that remain are omics and lab work. Contract research organizations hire master's statisticians at volume, but later and more rolling, and mostly in SAS. Southern California device companies run their own calendars: Stryker and Edwards' clinical track are open now; Medtronic's master's window closed October 13. Health plans posted a wave at the end of September, mostly undergraduate, MBA or pharmacy seats. J&J posts batches with short windows and sometimes moves them: its Oncology Epidemiology seat was re-posted October 16 with the close pushed a week to October 30.

items.title: Regeneron: 2027 Summer Intern, Biostatistics & Statistical Programming
items.location: Warren, New Jersey, or Tarrytown, New York (on site)
items.detail: Statistics behind clinical trials plus the programs and tools that analyze trial data for health authorities. Projects include new trial methods (multiple testing, blinded monitoring, recurrent-event endpoints), R Shiny applications and visualization libraries, and submission programming, so your Shiny app work lines up. The req says *Strong R skills (and often Python or SAS)* and also *Several projects are better suited to PhD students*, but it lists graduate students as eligible and GPA 3.0 preferred. Full-time, on site, May or June to August; pay $17.90 to $50.90 an hour by level. Dated October 28, req R52558. [Apply](https://regeneron.wd1.myworkdayjobs.com/Careers/job/TARRYTOWN/XMLNAME-2027-Summer-Intern-Biostatistics---Statistical-Programming_R52558-1)

You work with a senior statistician on a project in clinical trials, specialty data analytics or real-world data across infectious disease, oncology and rare disease. sections.title: What this page ranks against
sections.note: If any of this is wrong, say so and the ranking changes.

items.title: Private industry first: pharma, CROs, biotech
items.detail: Hospital systems and research institutes are fine; no government or public sector. Public universities and their hospitals are excluded; private nonprofits like Kaiser, Cedars-Sinai, City of Hope and Mayo are in.

items.title: Clinical trials, devices, health analytics
items.detail: Genomics stays on the map but ranks last.

items.title: Consulting: scientific yes, strategy no
items.detail: HEOR, epidemiology and economic consulting count (Analysis Group, Exponent). Strategy and management consulting does not (Guidehouse; ZS is out on that rule).

items.title: R and Python strong, SQL moderate, SAS in progress
items.detail: Also Tableau, R Shiny, ggplot2, scikit-learn; XGBoost recurrence model (AUC 0.75), SARIMA influenza capstone. Open question: **when does the SAS class end?** Reqs that say *SAS and/or R* are open to you now.

items.detail: Eleven rows outside these metros sit in Open now (New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Massachusetts, Minnesota); say if they should come off. Actuarial is on your title list; the first actuarial seats this cycle wanted a passed exam or an undergraduate, so say if you plan to sit an exam.
